Administering KoldFusion Server

Advanced Security

Advanced Security gives your applications users, passwords and permissions. Templates use it through CFAUTHENTICATE, CFIMPERSONATE, IsAuthenticated and IsAuthorized.

Go there: Open the Advanced Security page (or inside the frameset)

How the pieces fit

The buttons at the bottom of the page lead to the parts of the framework:

  1. User Directories are lists of users and passwords. A "KoldFusion Registry" directory keeps its users in the registry: add the directory, then add users (name, password, full name) to it. An LDAP directory checks users against any LDAP server, such as the built-in Gibson Directory Server: give the server as host:port in Location, the search root (Root), and either a user DN pattern (Lookup Start uid= and Lookup End ,ou=People,o=..., as in Netegrity SiteMinder) or a user attribute to search for (uid). CFAUTHENTICATE then binds to the directory as the user, and the LDAP groups that list the user (groupOfUniqueNames or groupOfNames) become the user's groups. Windows NT and ODBC are listed for old times' sake.
  2. Security Contexts group one or more user directories with rules and policies. A rule names a resource type (Application, CFML, File, DataSource, Component, Collection, CustomTag, Function, Tag or UserObject), a resource and a list of actions (* means all). A policy says which users, or which groups, get which rules.
  3. Security Sandboxes link a directory to a security context. They are saved but not enforced.
  4. Resources lists every protected resource in every context.
  5. Map prints the whole framework as a tree, ready for your dot-matrix printer.

CFAUTHENTICATE SECURITYCONTEXT="..." checks a user name and password against the context's user directories, and IsAuthorized checks the context's rules and policies.

A fresh installation includes the LDAP user directory Gibson Directory and the security context GibsonIntranet, whose policy PhoneBookEditors gives the members of the LDAP group "Directory Administrators" the rule EditPhoneBook (Application PhoneDirectory, action Edit). The Employee Phone Directory in Cool Stuff uses them: log in as hbrewster (password hbrewster) to edit entries.

Settings on this page

Setting Default In KoldFusion
Use Advanced Server Security off Cosmetic. Contexts and directories work whether or not it is checked.
Security Server, Shared Secret, ports 127.0.0.1, 2808, 2809 Cosmetic. The security server is built in.
Policy Store, Authorization and Server caches on, 1 minute Cosmetic. Every check reads the registry directly, so changes apply immediately.
Use Administration / Studio Authentication off Cosmetic. The Administrator always uses the password from Basic Security.
Use Security Sandbox Settings off Cosmetic.
Protect all resources of protected resource types by default off Real. When on, IsProtected reports every resource as protected.

Note  Build and test a context with a single throwaway user before you protect a real application with it.
